patient-self-with-representative.invalid.reason: a patient acting for themselves names no representative (AN-02)

prescription-transmission-state.invalid..reason: transmission and dispense states are reserved for a later governed change

received-at-impossible-day.integrity-inv.reason: 30 February passes the pattern but is not a real calendar time

recommendation-action-without-target.inv.expect_in_error: not valid under any of the given schemas

record-kind-missing.invalid.json.reason: every record says which record kind it is

released-item-back-dated.integrity-inval.reason: a released item dated by its first arrival instead of its release into the chart

signed-without-signed-event.invalid.json.reason: every signature is recorded as a signed lifecycle event (CA-03)

timestamp-out-of-range.invalid.json.reason: an hour, minute or second out of range is not a time
